text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that its board meeting had suspended trade in shares of the following companies:

- for one trading session - Inkaras, Baltic Vairas and Silutes Furniture, as their shares were not quoted for three months. After renewing trade, price fluctuation margins will not be applied, the bourse said in astatement.
- Krashto Projektai were suspended for three trading sessions after the number of shares in the issue was reduced.
- Malsena, for up to three month while the ordinary shares are being converted to agriculture producers' shares.
- Endokrininiai Preparatai, up to three month because of an increase of the authorised capital from the company's reserves.
- Birshtono Mineral Water, because of the general shareholders' meeting
The bourse also said in a statement that it okayed the resumption trade in shares of A group company Sema from May 13 after its share capital boost was legalised.
